title: Spotify Playlist & Podcast Monitor Output
description: Public Spotify metadata plus persistent watchlist comparisons, changed-only delivery, and downloadable JSON/CSV monitoring reports.

results.title: Spotify metadata records
results.description: Clean parent-item records containing public Spotify metadata, included nested tracks, and optional change fields. Nested tracks are included in the parent item charge.

monitoringReport.title: Monitoring report (JSON)
monitoringReport.description: Run totals and per-item baseline, changed, unchanged, track-add/remove/reorder, and new-featured-item results.

monitoringCsv.title: Monitoring report (CSV)
monitoringCsv.description: Spreadsheet-ready change report for scheduled playlist, artist, album, and podcast watchlists.
